From THE AMERICAN MEDICAL MARIJUANA ASSOCIATION
2/4/00

AMMA Mission Statement
by Steve Kubby, National Director

Freedom is always the highest goal and therefore can never be used as a bargaining chip for something else. No goal, no cause, no reward is worth sacrificing our freedom and it is only through freedom that genuine life, liberty and the pursuit of happiness is possible.

Freedom is never legal and is never handed out. As Albert Einstein said, " Our Bill of Rights is no stronger than each citizen's determination to defend those rights. " Freedom doesn't come from appeasing police, begging Congress, or voting for the lesser of two evils.

Any plea bargain, legislative compromise, or deal with prosecutors, judges or police will only end up eroding our freedom and endangering others.

Any lawful act that exposes corrupt police, prosecutors or politicians will only end up educating and freeing our fellow citizens.

Any political change, to be truly effective, must be nonviolent. Nonviolence means not hitting back at our opponents. That includes not using the Internet to trash our opponents. The goal of nonviolence is to educate and persuade our adversaries instead of trying to harm them.
See
The Marijuana Resistance Movement
Beyond Reform: From Ideas To Action.
Analysis By Richard Cowan

The tactic of nonviolence, as taught by Gandhi is to provoke authorities until they take actions that exposes their injustice and corruption. Such provocative actions by AMMA will inevitably draw criticism from our own side, but Gandhi's formula has stood the test of time and can serve us well as a guide.
